data.description:
## Description

**What**: Populate the patterns domain with agentic design patterns for AI caseworker tools, covering SC-4 sub-domain (i).

**Why**: SC-4 sub-domain (i) requires agentic patterns including multi-level transparency, human-in-the-loop interactions, and plain-language pairs for agentic interfaces. No existing story covers this sub-domain (c642-4840 covers dark/behavioral/cognitive patterns, not agentic). As DSO agents increasingly generate UI for AI-augmented government services, this pattern set is essential reference.

**Scope**:
- IN: patterns domain Markdown files for agentic patterns: multi-level transparency (status indicator, tool call log, data source labels); human-in-the-loop interaction patterns; persistent intervention controls; plain-language do and dont pairs for agentic interfaces
- OUT: Dark patterns, behavioral patterns, cognitive load patterns (covered by c642-4840)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the patterns domain contains >=5 schema-valid entries covering agentic UI patterns: multi-level transparency, human-in-the-loop interactions, and persistent intervention controls
  <- Satisfies: sc-4  (sub-domain (i): Agentic design patterns)

- When this story is complete, agentic pattern entries include plain-language do and dont pairs for agentic interfaces
  <- Satisfies: sc-4

- When this story is complete, all entries are schema-valid with required fields: rule_id, prior_art, precedence, domain: patterns
  <- Satisfies: sc-1

- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh patterns "human in the loop" returns >=1 result specifically about agentic interaction patterns
  <- Satisfies: sc-4

- When this story is complete, Summary and Detail tiers are populated for all entries (Implementation is stretch)
  <- Satisfies: sc-4

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked.
data.title: As an agent implementing an AI caseworker tool, I can query agentic UI patterns (multi-level transparency, human-in-the-loop, intervention controls) from the corpus
